about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Get to know me
about.p1: I'm a full stack developer at Anuubis Solutions, where I keep a fleet of close to a thousand sites running across eight servers. My work covers deployments, migrations between hosting providers, audits, and incident response. Nearly all of it is scripted, because at that scale manual work is what takes sites down.
about.p2: Outside of work, I build my own tools, usually in Python and Node. I also use Claude Code every day as part of my development workflow.

projects.title: SaveMyMoneyNow
projects.description: Turns bank statements into a spending dashboard. An assistant handles each bank's format by detecting headers and mapping columns, while rules categorize transactions and catch duplicates.

projects.title: Atalaya
projects.description: A Python CLI that aggregates remote developer roles from eight job boards, scores each match against your profile, and drafts the cover letter with Claude. It has 147 tests and uses mypy in strict mode.

projects.title: Strev
projects.description: A MERN fitness SaaS in private beta, with cookie-based authentication, workout tracking, and personalized routines powered by Claude.
